name: Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd.
blurb: Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. is a South Korean multinational electronics company and the world's largest manufacturer of memory chips, smartphones, and consumer electronics. It operates through four divisions: Device eXperience (DX), Device Solutions (DS), SDC, and Harman, covering products from smartphones and TVs to semiconductors and home appliances. As of 2026, it holds a dominant market position in memory and mobile devices, with a market cap exceeding 1,700 trillion KRW.
recent: In the past 30 days, Samsung Electronics reported strong quarterly earnings driven by blistering memory price hikes, leading to a 46% increase in fair value estimates. The stock hit a 52-week high of 277,000 KRW, reflecting a 390% year-over-year gain. Analysts have raised price targets amid robust demand for AI-related memory chips.
